known_information: The supplied screenshot explicitly maps Caps Lock to Ctrl, resolving the reversed wording in part of the body.

initial_investigation: Read all replies and inspected the original remap screenshot.

issue_context.analysis: Another enabled input hook or a modifier-state interaction may interfere with Caps Lock to Ctrl. Isolate one module at a time and distinguish external ctrl2cap configuration before choosing a handler change; do not recommend installing another remapping driver as a product repair.
